references: WHO — Dengue and severe dengue fact sheet (World Health Organization, 2026 revision)
CDC — Dengue Around the World / areas with risk of dengue map (US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, 2026)
_sources.note: Coarse country-level endemicity tiers compiled from the two references above. This table is a travel-context aid only: it is not surveillance data, it carries no case counts, and it is never used to compute a risk score. Sub-national detail lives in the per-country 'season' note.

Brazil.season: Year-round transmission; epidemic peak January to May in the southeast.

Indonesia.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, roughly November to April.

Philippines.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to November.

India.season: Peaks after the monsoon, July to November, in most states.

Bangladesh.season: Peaks June to October; large urban epidemics in Dhaka.

Thailand.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, May to October.

Vietnam.season: Year-round; peaks June to November, earlier in the south.

Malaysia.season: Year-round; rises with the monsoon rains, roughly October to March.

Singapore.season: Year-round; warmer months of June to October usually see the highest counts.

Mexico.season: Coastal and southern states; peaks July to November.

Colombia.season: Year-round below 2000 m; peaks in the two rainy seasons.

Peru.season: Amazon and northern coast; peaks January to May.

Sri Lanka.season: Year-round; peaks after both monsoons, May to July and October to December.

Pakistan.season: Peaks after the monsoon, August to November, especially in Sindh and Punjab.

Cambodia.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to October.

Laos.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to September.

Myanmar.season: Peaks in the rainy season, June to September.

Nigeria.season: Year-round in the south; often under-reported and confused with malaria.

Kenya.season: Coastal and north-eastern counties; peaks after the long rains, April to July.

Venezuela.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to November.

Ecuador.season: Coastal lowlands and Amazon; peaks January to May.

Bolivia.season: Lowland departments; peaks January to April.

Honduras.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to November.

Nicaragua.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to November.

Guatemala.season: Lowlands and Pacific coast; peaks June to November.

El Salvador.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to October.

Costa Rica.season: Pacific and Caribbean lowlands; peaks in the rainy season, May to November.

Panama.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, May to November.

Dominican Republic.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, May to November.

Cuba.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to November.

Haiti.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, April to November.

Jamaica.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, September to November.

Trinidad and Tobago.season: Year-round; peaks in the rainy season, June to December.

Nepal.season: Expanding above the Terai; peaks after the monsoon, August to November.

Maldives.season: Year-round; peaks with the south-west monsoon, May to October.

Timor-Leste.season: Peaks in the rainy season, December to April.

Papua New Guinea.season: Year-round in coastal and lowland areas.

Fiji.season: Peaks in the wet season, November to April; outbreak-prone.

Sudan.season: Eastern states and Red Sea coast; peaks after the rains, September to December.

Yemen.season: Coastal governorates; year-round with post-rain peaks.

Somalia.season: Southern and coastal regions; peaks after the rains.

Tanzania.season: Coastal regions including Dar es Salaam; peaks March to June.

Angola.season: Urban outbreaks reported, chiefly in Luanda during the rains.

Burkina Faso.season: Urban outbreaks in Ouagadougou; peaks August to November.

Côte d'Ivoire.season: Urban transmission in Abidjan; peaks in the rainy seasons.

Saudi Arabia.season: Western region only — Jeddah, Makkah and Jazan; peaks April to July.

Argentina.season: Northern provinces and Buenos Aires; summer season, January to May.

Paraguay.season: Summer season, December to May; outbreak-prone in Asunción.

Uruguay.season: Sporadic summer transmission only, January to April.

Chile.season: Mainland is free of the vector; Easter Island has had local transmission.

China.season: Local transmission is confined to the south — Guangdong, Yunnan, Fujian, Guangxi and Hainan — typically August to November. Northern provinces have no established transmission.

Northern China.season: No established local transmission; reported cases are imported.

Taiwan.season: Local outbreaks in the south — Tainan and Kaohsiung — typically August to November.

Hong Kong.season: Mostly imported cases with occasional local clusters, June to October.

United States.season: Limited local transmission — south Florida, the Texas Gulf coast and Hawaii; late summer to autumn. Most of the country has none.

Australia.season: Far north Queensland only, from imported introductions; wet season, November to April.

Japan.season: No established transmission; a single Tokyo cluster in 2014 was not sustained.

South Korea.season: No local transmission; all reported cases are imported.

United Kingdom.season: No local transmission; all reported cases are imported.

Germany.season: No established local transmission; imported cases only.

Canada.season: No local transmission; all reported cases are imported.

Ireland.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

Netherlands.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

Sweden.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

Norway.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

Poland.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

Russia.season: No established local transmission; imported cases only.

New Zealand.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

Mongolia.season: No local transmission; imported cases only.

France.season: Small summer clusters in the Mediterranean south, June to October; the overseas territories are far higher.

Spain.season: Rare local cases in the Mediterranean east, August to October.

Portugal.season: Mainland has none; Madeira had a large outbreak in 2012-2013.

Italy.season: Occasional local clusters in the north and Lazio, July to October.

Croatia.season: Isolated local cases on the Adriatic coast in late summer.

Greece.season: Vector present; sporadic local transmission in late summer.

Israel.season: Vector established; sporadic local clusters in the coastal plain.

United Arab Emirates.season: Limited local transmission; mostly imported cases.

Egypt.season: Sporadic outbreaks in Upper Egypt and the Red Sea coast.

Iran.season: Newly emerging in the south-east; first local transmission reported in 2024.

Chad.season: Urban outbreaks in N'Djamena; peaks after the rains, August to November.
